title: A write whose index record and orphan removal both fail reports only the first after-write note
body:
Found by ST0096's catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H1-* and close-H3-*). Fixed under hv decision 86 in cc's d86c for 3.5.1.

facade.rs (about 22958) folds the two after-write notes with unindexed.or(unremoved), so when both steps fail the orphan removal's note is dropped and the operator never hears that a record's files were left behind. Expected: both notes surface.
